text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So this is... Ayabe-san's running in an actual race...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(It's different... from me...
Not better or worse, just...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(The running itself... No,
it's not just the running. What's even more different is...)

Having her run alongside others made it crystal clear.
Admire Vega's greatest weapon is undeniably her "sharp burst of speed on the final stretch."

Whether the front-runners exhaust themselves in a high pace,
or it becomes a battle of late kicks in a slow pace...
Either way, she's a threat.

Yet I felt her true threat wasn't her burst of speed.
What was even more terrifying was—
It's like an "obsession" she stakes on racing. Just why does she...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe... -san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Did you get that?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You really shouldn't wish to run like me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Aiming for it is pointless. It's not worth pursuing.
To strive for something is simply—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Just... losing it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You and I belong in different places.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: A place... to belong...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You look at the summit from the ground.
However...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: From the very bottom of rock bottom, I look up at the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You run because you want to win.
However...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I run because I cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Today was still just like a dress rehearsal.
But next time—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going in to win for real.
—Because I can't afford to lose."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe... -san...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
In the end... I'm still not sure I understand.
The secret behind Ayabe-san's incredible presence.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Still, there is one thing I understand now.
At this rate, I might not be able to win the Satsuki Sho..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"No, whether it's the Nihon Derby or the Kikuka Sho.
That's why—!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I want to get stronger!
Even just a little bit!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A run worthy of everyone's cheers!
Without leaving behind even the slightest regret.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's push ourselves to the limit!
Yeah, let's push ourselves to the limit!

text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road and Admire Vega have only just entered the Classic tier.
It's precisely because they're incomplete...

One misstep and your condition falls apart.
Conversely, that could also serve as an opening to exploit.
I wanted to get Narita Top Road into the best condition possible somehow. But—

Leading up to the Satsuki Sho, and on the day itself.
You never know what might happen.
